_readme: GST rates per HSN, from the CBIC rate notifications (GST 2.0, in force from 22 September 2025).
Each code lists every rate the notifications allow for goods under it. An entry in the schedule
is limited by its description as well as its code, so one code often carries two rates (toothpaste
5% and other oral-care goods 18% under 3306). A code's rates include those of its heading and of
whole-chapter entries, because a product under it may be one of those goods.
Built from: 9/2025-CT(Rate) Schedules I-VI (Schedule VII omitted by 19/2025); 10/2025-CT(Rate)
2202); corrigendum to 9/2025 (re-lettering only). Entries naming 'any chapter' without a code are
not represented. Codes absent here get no schedule opinion; the shop-comparison check still runs.
source=verified: taken from the notification. A product whose rate is not in its code's list is
